fato_historico: 1989: The Standard Gravure shooting where Joseph T. Wesbecker, a 47-year-old pressman, killed eight people and injured 12 people at his former workplace, Standard Gravure, before committing suicide.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace deep emotional release today. Just as the world occasionally faces shadows, remember that your sensitivity is a superpower for healing. It is a good time to clear heavy energy and seek peace. Perhaps consider offering kindness to those struggling, as your compassionate presence may provide a much-needed sanctuary for someone lost in darkness.
frase_do_dia: Your gentle heart is the light that guides others home through the storm.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite cycles of transformation and spiritual renewal today.
conselho: Protect your inner peace by choosing surroundings that nurture your gentle soul.
